data.action: 矮桌旁核对完花束预算合上家计簿，向镜头露出没有超支的满足笑
data.description: 【白银家公寓客厅·清晨】圭穿着简洁的银白婚纱坐在矮桌前，旁边仍放着她整理过的家计簿与一束便宜但新鲜的小花；她核对完最后一笔预算，才抬眼向镜头露出“这次没有超支”的满足笑。
data.lighting: gentle morning light across the low table
data.mood: 把精打细算也变成花嫁幸福
data.promptProse: Kei Shirogane sits at the apartment’s low table in her simple silver-white bridal dress and modest veil, finishing the last entry in the household budget. The small fresh bouquet remains beside the ledger. She looks up with satisfaction beneath her black ribbon headband. In the vertical medium-full view, the dress folds spread beside the table, the sofa back sits farther behind and the morning window is visible at the room’s side. Gentle morning light brightens the ledger and flowers; bouquet stems cast fine shadows on the paper, while the table edge leaves a softer band across the nearer dress folds.
data.title: 白银圭 · 预算表旁的银色花嫁
